app.title: RAG Evaluation
evidence.unavailableNote: Adapter capability is unavailable. This is not a zero score.
evidence.emptyNote: The stage ran and returned an empty result.
page.datasets.title: Dataset bundles
page.datasets.description: Gold answers and evidence remain outside every Worker sandbox. A changed byte produces a new bundle ID.
page.systems.title: Trusted local worker registry
page.systems.description: Systems are registered by local CLI only. Credentials never cross into API responses.
page.systems.empty: Register a Worker system from the trusted local CLI.
page.experiments.title: Config, not branches
page.experiments.description: An ExperimentSpec fixes system, selection, seed, stages, metrics, and repetition policy.
page.runs.title: Runs
page.runs.description: Timeouts, crashes, empty answers, and unavailable capabilities remain visible.
page.runs.empty: No new-platform runs. Legacy directories are intentionally invisible.
page.runDetail.title: Run detail
page.runDetail.description: A durable view of one run artifact. It links directly to its existing case evidence without changing the artifact.
page.runDetail.notFound: Run {{id}} was not found in the current Platform home.
page.cases.title: Case-level failure anatomy
page.cases.description: Follow evidence from native retrieval through ranking and the exact final context.
page.cases.question: Question / Rep {{repetition}} / Seed {{seed}}
page.cases.goldEvidenceRule: all groups required · any item within group
page.cases.latencyNote: End-to-end query latency is Platform wall-clock from query dispatch through response validation. Native retrieval/generation timings, when present, are adapter diagnostics rather than cross-system speed claims.
page.compare.title: Comparison with an explicit contract
page.compare.description: Every metric declares its own coverage and comparability. Exploratory analysis never declares a winner; strict comparison requires a preregistered ComparisonSpec.
page.overview.title: Evaluation workspace
page.overview.description: A guided workspace for reproducible RAG evaluation. Research artifacts remain immutable.
page.overview.readyDescription: Choose a sealed dataset and a configured system to generate a canonical ExperimentSpec.
page.overview.setupDescription: Add a dataset and a standard RAG system before starting an evaluation.
product.datasets.title: Datasets
product.datasets.description: Upload a validated Bundle, or create a small TXT/Markdown Bundle with manually confirmed Gold evidence.
product.datasets.uploadDescription: One ZIP file is validated in a private staging area before it is registered.
product.datasets.localPathNote: This path is resolved on the machine running Platform, not in the browser. The validated Bundle is copied into managed storage.
product.datasets.localRegistered: Bundle {{id}}… registered from the local Platform host.
product.datasets.sealedNote: A changed byte always creates a new Bundle ID.
product.datasets.createDescription: Select a text span in the source, then enter the Question and Gold Answer. The locator is generated and validated on seal.
product.datasets.name: Dataset name
product.datasets.sourcePlaceholder: Paste UTF-8 TXT or Markdown source…
product.datasets.question: Question
product.datasets.validated: Draft validates as a Bundle 2.0 dataset.
product.systems.title: Systems
product.systems.description: Configure a standard RAG system without exposing adapter factories, runtimes, or credentials in the Basic flow.
product.systems.name: System name
product.systems.defaultsNote: Versioned defaults are fully expanded into every generated ExperimentSpec.
product.systems.advancedLegacyNote: Custom adapters remain an Advanced/CLI workflow. Their factory, runtime, capabilities, and environment are never shown in Basic.
product.systems.credentialsNote: Values are written only to local secure storage and are never returned by Platform.
product.wizard.title: New evaluation
product.wizard.description: Choose a Dataset and standard system; Platform expands versioned defaults into one canonical ExperimentSpec, then uses the existing RunExecutor.
product.wizard.profileDefaults: {{profile}}@{{version}} defaults will be fully expanded and frozen in the generated ExperimentSpec.
product.wizard.noProfile: Select a configured standard system to load its versioned defaults.
product.wizard.ready: Canonical ExperimentSpec is ready for review.
product.wizard.queued: Evaluation was frozen and queued through the existing RunExecutor.
product.wizard.modelsRequired: Choose both a generation model and an embedding model before review.
product.wizard.invalidInteger: {{label}} must be an integer greater than or equal to {{minimum}}.
error.dockerAction: Start Docker Desktop or OrbStack, then test the connection again.
error.runtimeAction: Start the configured model service and confirm the selected model is available.
error.modelAction: Install or select an available model, then retry the connection test.
error.datasetTitle: The dataset Bundle could not be imported
error.datasetAction: Choose one valid Bundle ZIP with intact checksums and try again.
error.secretTitle: A required credential is not available
error.secretAction: Configure the credential in the local secure store, then retry.
error.timeoutAction: Check the RAG system and model runtime, then retry.
error.connectionTitle: The RAG system could not connect
error.connectionAction: Test the system again after checking its local runtime and adapter installation.
error.genericTitle: The operation could not be completed
error.genericAction: Review the technical details and correct the configuration before retrying.
